advisories.problem: installInterjectionExpirySweep registers on 'agent/pre-step' with no once-per-agent guard, so it runs on EVERY model step, while the region comment and frozen-contract.json.interjectionExpiryBoundary.statement describe the second expiry event as 'a SESSION START in the workspace'. The module's own gate proves the event fires per step: it needs settledFor (session-start.js:496-498) to run only once. Behaviour is eager but idempotent and best-effort, so nothing is broken; the cost is a readdir plus one read per team on the hottest path in the agent loop, and the stated boundary is inaccurate.
advisories.requiredFix: Either add a per-session guard mirroring settledFor, or restate the event as 'every pre-step, the session's first included' in the comment and in interjectionExpiryBoundary. Small change; best folded into t52's in-flight work, which already edits this area.
